verdict.rationale: CrewAI has no documented native natural-language command interface for driving the product itself. It offers a ready-to-paste setup prompt that installs official CrewAI skills, so coding agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can operate it from natural-language instructions (crewai-docs-58). Agents and tasks are also specified as natural-language roles, goals and descriptions (crewai-docs-60, crewai-docs-61). The product itself is still run through code, CLI commands or the no-code visual builders, and NL operation depends on a third-party agent. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language or chat interface to create, run and manage crews; documentation of NL-driven operation beyond the agent setup prompt; independent or hands-on corroboration.
